summary: Tested the new 'Recently Played' feature end-to-end. Backend: 11/11 tests pass. Frontend: all 9 specified scenarios verified. The recently-played strip renders correctly with frosted-glass styling, shows 3 seeded admin games (Easter Match 3 Saga, Plane Runner 3D, Get rich in), thumbnail click navigates to /play/[gameId], dismiss hides the strip and restores topPad from 188px→68px, guest users correctly do NOT see the strip, feed functionality intact.

minor.issue: Returns HTTP 403 (not 401) when no token provided — FastAPI's HTTPBearer security returns 403 'Not authenticated' for missing credentials and 401 for invalid tokens. This is standard FastAPI behavior, not a bug, but worth noting for clients expecting strict 401.

critical_code_review_comments: CORRECT: /games/recently-played endpoint is placed at line 888, BEFORE the /games/{game_id} wildcard at line 921 — critical route ordering is correct.
CORRECT: Endpoint uses get_current_user (not get_optional_user) — correctly enforces auth.
CORRECT: Query deduplicates via GROUP BY game_id and orders by max(played_at) DESC — returns unique games most recent first.
CORRECT: Frontend only fetches recently-played when token is present (if (!token) return) — no unnecessary calls for guests.
CORRECT: showRecent = recentGames.length > 0 && !recentDismissed — correctly conditions on having played at least 1 game and not dismissed.
CORRECT: topPad = showRecent ? 188 : 68 — correct spacing logic for strip visibility.

NOTE: AnimatePresence wraps the strip but the conditional is outside (showRecent check in parent). The strip is conditionally rendered in the parent, not inside AnimatePresence, so exit animation won't fire. This is a minor UX gap (no slide-out animation on dismiss), not a functional bug.
seed_data_creation: None — used existing 3 play sessions seeded for admin (Easter Match 3 Saga, Plane Runner 3D, Get rich in)

Frontend runs in next start production mode.
rca_of_issue: No bugs found. Minor AnimatePresence note: The exit animation on dismiss won't fire because the conditional check (showRecent) lives outside the AnimatePresence component. The strip is removed from DOM immediately on dismiss without a slide-out animation. To fix, move the conditional inside AnimatePresence or use a key-based approach. This is cosmetic only.
